system.description:
Transfiguration

Special Amp (Fortitude)

You are temporally Transfigured having your cells, organs and biological makeup slightly adjusted to better match one of the following designations chosen by the allied Medical-Nin that applied this effect.

Avian: You gain a flying speed equal to your movement speed, but must land at the end of your turn. You gain immunity to fall damage and cannot be knocked prone.

Carnivoran: You gain a bonus to your [Unarmed Damage] and [Weapon Damage] equal to the Medical-Nin’s Channeled Healing bonus.

Herbivore: You gain DR equal to the Medical-Nin’s Channeled Healing bonus.

Insectoid: You gain Darkvision and Chakra Sight out to 60ft and resistance to Chakra Damage.

Medical-Nin who follow the path of the Transmuter learn to battle with surgical precision, altering the very fabric of the creature, be it friend, foe, or themselves, making specific or broad alterations to their very biology.

Transfigured Technique – Transfiguration

Transfiguration is treated as a Physical Condition.

A Transfigured creature suffers one of following effects based on the chosen designation. This cannot be changed, for its duration, unless the creature is Transfigured again.

Avian. A transfigured (Avian) creature loses bone density and weight. They make saving throws and checks to resist being moved against their will, knocked prone or Dazed with a -2 penalty.

Carnivoran. A transfigured (Carnivoran) creature loses their ability to defend themselves effectively, suffering a -2 penalty to their Dexterity and Constitution saving throws.

Herbivore. A transfigured (Herbivore) creature loses their ability fight effectively, suffering a penalty to the damage they deal, reducing the number of dice they roll for damage by 1.

Insectoid. A transfigured (Insectoid) creature loses their ability to avoid encounters. They cannot cast jutsu with a Casting time of Reaction that grants a bonus to their Saving throws or AC.
